summary: Verified SEC-002 (static server allowlist) and SEC-003 (upload type restriction + nosniff). 26/26 pytest cases pass on the public preview URL. Frontend homepage renders normally and Backstage opens with all 5 tabs (EDIT/REQUESTS/STATS/COUNTRIES/SETTINGS) using password candice2026.

SEC-002_secret_leak_closed.notes: No response body contained MONGO_URL, EMERGENT_LLM_KEY, or ADMIN_UPLOAD_PASS. Response body for /backend/.env is HTML, not env content.

SEC-003_upload_type_restriction.html_upload: POST /api/media/upload/complete with content_type=text/html -> 415 'Only image or video files are allowed'
SEC-003_upload_type_restriction.nosniff_header: GET /api/media/file/{id} returned X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff and CSP sandbox headers

action_items: SEC-001 (client-side admin password hardcoded in admin.js) is intentionally still open pending auth redesign — not verified this round.
critical_code_review_comments: server.js allowlist implementation is clean: uses path.basename() to flatten user input, preventing traversal. Explicit ALLOWED Set, non-allowlisted paths fall back to index.html. No dotfiles, no directory serving.
server.py upload_complete correctly rejects non image/video BEFORE storage upload (415).
serve_file adds both X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff and CSP sandbox — good defense-in-depth against XSS via uploaded HTML.
Note: media_type in serve_file uses record's stored content_type; combined with the 415 filter at upload time, this is safe.
Reminder: SEC-001 remains — admin.js contains password check client-side (visible in /admin.js which IS in the allowlist). Any visitor can read it. Auth must be moved server-side.
test_credentials: Admin pass: candice2026 (from review request; DO NOT change).
seed_data_creation: One test JPEG uploaded via /api/media/upload flow to verify nosniff. Small (1x1 px) file; id logged in pytest output. No cleanup performed (no delete endpoint).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Security regression suite at /app/backend/tests/test_security_fixes.py covers SEC-002 (static allowlist + traversal) and SEC-003 (upload 415 + nosniff). Reuse for future security regressions. SEC-001 (client-side admin password in admin.js) is still open by design.
